overview_description.description:
Humble Bundle's award-winning team has raise over $75 million for charity. They empower you to pay what you want for downloadable content and choose where your money goes.

They now have over 7M customers accessing their platform.

Humble Bundle was founded in March 2010 by Jeffrey Rosen and John Graham, and is currently headquartered in San Francisco, California, USA.

about_short_description.short_description: Humble Bundle is an online digital distribution platform that contributes part of its sales value to charities.

product.name: Humble Bundles
product.description: Limited-time digital collections of games, books, software, and other content sold through tiered, pay-what-you-want pricing with a portion of proceeds directed to charities.

product.name: Humble Store
product.description: An online digital storefront for purchasing individual video games, books, software, and related digital content across platforms such as Windows, Mac, Linux, Steam, and Nintendo Switch.

product.name: Humble Choice
product.description: A membership service that provides subscribers with a recurring selection of PC games and other member benefits through the Humble platform.

product.name: Humble Games Publishing
product.description: A game publishing service associated with Humble that supports the release and distribution of selected video games.
